hostname rt-w01
!
ip name-server 2001:db8:0:53::1
!
ipv6 unicast-routing
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 ipv6 address 2001:db8:0:2::1/64
 ipv6 enable
 no shutdown
!
ip sla 1
 icmp-echo 2001:db8:ff::10 source-interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 frequency 10
ip sla schedule 1 life forever start-time now
track 1 ip sla 1 reachability
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 192.0.2.254 1 track 1
!
ipv6 route 2001:db8:ff::/48 GigabitEthernet0/1 fe80::1
!
logging facility local0
logging source-interface GigabitEthernet0/1
logging host ipv6 2001:db8:0:50::1
!
snmp-server community example-ro RO
snmp-server host 2001:db8:0:162::1 version 2c example-ro
!
ntp server 2001:db8:0:123::1
!
end
